The '''Credaan Spacer''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was equipped with reverse [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]], forward and rear [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], and an on-board [[Computer/Legends|computer]] as well as a [[Comm unit/Legends|commport]]. The computer allowed the ship's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to identify and view the trajectories of nearby spacecraft and to also view a [[Star map/Legends|star map]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ship's thrusters and deflector shields could be controlled via voice commands to the computer, and it could in turn announce the remaining strength of the craft's shielding as percentages.<ref name="Tethan" /> The Credaan Spacer shared its name with the [[Credaan system/Legends|Credaan system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Credaan Spacer was exclusively used by the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Tethan" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]'' is set during the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> an old, outdated Credaan Spacer was located in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] aboard the Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Spirit of the Republic]]'' while the latter was in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]<ref name="Tethan" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Possible journeys===
{{Quote|You have a meeting with Master Windu?''"<br />"''Why, yes I do. Would you like to meet him? Before my guards escort you back to your ship?|A youngling and Padmé Amidala in an adventure path in ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
[[File:Spirit_of_the_Republic.png|thumb|right|250px|In ''The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure'', the Tethan youngling protagonist can depart the ''Spirit of the Republic'' (pictured) on a Credaan Spacer.]]
The Credaan Spacer appeared in [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure|''Tethan Battle Adventure'']], [[Sue Behrent]]'s [[2010]] entry in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny]]'' series of choose-your-own-adventure books. In one adventure path the reader may take in the book's story, the [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|protagonist]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Tethan]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], can accompany [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the Galactic Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''Spirit of the Republic'', with the question posed to the former as to whether they wish to join the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Since the Star Destroyer must depart Teth, if the youngling decides not to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Kenobi leads them to the starship's hangar to find a suitable vessel for them to travel back home on. The only vessel that the Tethan can borrow is a Credaan Spacer, on which they exit the hangar before the youngling realizes that, before returning home, they can travel anywhere they wish.<ref name="Tethan" />

[[File:Coruscant-EotE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The youngling can use the Credaan Spacer to travel to Coruscant (pictured).]]
At that point, the reader is presented with three choices: if they choose to return to Teth straight away after all, the youngling displays a [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Map/Legends|map]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] on the screen of the Credaan Spacer's on-board computer and studies potential destinations before deciding to instead return home. Alternatively, the Tethan can choose to go to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Tethan" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of the Republic,<ref name="TEA" /> where they visit various locales including the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. There, the youngling meets [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]<ref name="Tethan" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="TEA" /> who eventually introduces them to Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] before the former's [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] escort the Tethan back to their starship.<ref name="Tethan" />

===Travel to Tatooine===
{{Quote|Zenhoo bala wowga peepu?''"<br />"''The mighty Jabba would like to know why you come to Tatooine in a Credaan Spacer. A ship you could have only acquired from the Republican Army.|Jabba Desilijic Tiure and TC-70, to the youngling in another path in ''Tethan Battle Adventure''|<ref name="Tethan" />}}
[[File:Tatoo_system_TOR.png|thumb|right|250px|In another path in ''Tethan Battle Adventure'', the Credaan Spacer can journey to Tatooine (pictured).]]
Finally, the youngling can fulfill their dream of visiting the famed Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="Tethan" /> the Outer Rim<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], albeit not before briefly feeling guilty while imagining Kenobi's reaction to them "taking a Credaan Spacer joyriding around the galaxy." While the Tethan's craft is approaching Tatooine's orbit, however, a trio of [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class Porax-38 starfighters]] piloted by [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] advance toward it from behind one of the planet's [[Tatoo I/Legends|two]] [[Tatoo II/Legends|suns]]. After confirming the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters']] identity via the Credaan Spacer's computer, the youngling can either surrender to them or attempt to evade them.<ref name="Tethan" />

[[File:Jabba_TCWPB.png|thumb|left|250px|In an adventure path, Jabba Desilijic Tiure (pictured) may interrogate the youngling as to the provenance of the Credaan Spacer.]]
If the Tethan surrenders, reasoning that they could not outrun the pursuing starships in a Credaan Spacer&mdash;misspelled as "Creedan Spacer" in that section of the book&mdash;they land on Tatooine and disembark, after which the IG-100 MagnaGuards escort them to the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. There, Jabba&mdash;with his speech translated by the [[TC-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[TC-70/Legends|TC-70]]&mdash;inquires as to why the youngling has arrived on the Republic Military's Credaan Spacer, prompting the Tethan to give him a brief account of their journey from Teth.<ref name="Tethan" />

[[File:RogueClassFighters-TCWf.png|thumb|right|250px|A confrontation with several ''Rogue''-class Porax-38 starfighters (pictured) can lead to the Credaan Spacer being destroyed.]]
If the youngling decides to try and outmaneuver the MagnaGuards' fighters, they doubtfully observe the interior of the Credaan Spacer's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]], deliberating on the capabilities of the "hunk of junk." Strengthening the vessel's rear deflector shields and activating its reverse thrusters, the Tethan evades the pursuers before going on to dive to within [[Foot/Legends|feet]] of Tatooine's surface, in the process leading one of the starfighters to crash. Transferring power to the Credaan Spacer's forward shields, the youngling then launches a frontal assault on their pursuers, intending to intimidating them into veering away from the impending collision. Upon being contacted by a MagnaGuard who delivers an intimidating threat, however, the Tethan realizes that their opponents will not back away and, determined to destroy the droids, pilots the Credaan Spacer to a fatal collision with the two other craft.<ref name="Tethan" />
